name: hugmesh-forum-ui-e2e
description: Playwright + playwright-bdd e2e harness for the hugmesh-forum-ui federated remote. Copied from the proven hugmesh.games/e2e + hugmesh-admin-ui/e2e pattern. Ships dark (wave 2b): every cluster-dependent scenario is @cluster-tagged so the suite compiles and discovers offline without a live phpBB/forum-bff stack.
